title.rendered: Withdrawing Your Student Over the Summer?

content.rendered: Moving out of Sherwood this summer? Enrolling your child in a different district for next year? Please take a moment to fill out our Student Withdrawal – Summer Notification Form. With our school offices closed during the summer, completing this form will notify our District Office, allowing us to assist you as needed with collecting remaining lunch funds, having your student’s records transferred, or a number of other tasks that may need our attention to help you and your child have a smooth transition from our district. Simply click the link or scan the QR code to get started!
